next.reason: 1985 GR8: the record must not be larger than the largest or smaller than the smallest size the RECORD IS VARYING clause allows; otherwise the WRITE is unsuccessful, does not take place, leaves the record area unaffected and sets the status to the cause (1985 Indexed I-O status 44). 2023 §2023:14.9.51.4 GR14 keeps the bounds and sets '44'; §2023:14.9.51.4 GR15 gives the same unsuccessful-WRITE effect; §2023:9.1.13.7 GR4 defines 44 as this boundary violation. Bytes vs character positions is unit wording for 1985's alphanumeric records; literal-1, FILE and FORMAT are 2023-only syntax. Run-time in both. Same.
